description: This file defines the `OrderSetAttributeType` class, a subclass extending `BaseAttributeType<OrderSet>` with additional properties and methods. It is part of the OpenMRS core API, representing a user-defined extension for order set attribute types, including getter and setter methods and annotations for auditing.

classes.name: OrderSetAttributeType
classes.description: A subclass of BaseAttributeType specific to OrderSet, with an additional ID and annotated for auditing.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attribute type, delegating to getOrderSetAttributeTypeId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the attribute type, delegating to setOrderSetAttributeTypeId().

methods.name: getOrderSetAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ID for this attribute type.

methods.name: setOrderSetAttributeTypeId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID for this attribute type.
